Full Shoot

Architecture, Heritage, and Intent.

Conceived as a dialogue between traditional Rajasthani craftsmanship and contemporary couture silhouettes, Rutbaa by Meet brings regal opulence into modern light. The campaign emphasizes intricate gold zardozi and needlework on deep emerald silk and rich navy fabrics, staged against sun-bleached palace archways.

Every frame was lit and framed to accentuate the garment’s weight, movement, and artisanal depth — pairing grand architectural scale with intimate textile details ready for multi-channel storytelling.
